How Can I Help You?

I am able to help your businesses grow by giving you access to several secure and efficient tools and resources we offer. Some of the tools available include Online Banking, ACH Origination, Online Entitlements, Lockbox Services, Merchant Credit Card processing, Positive Pay, Remote Deposit Services, and Wire Transfers. I will be there to walk you through each step needed to set up and use each tool, and will help you with any questions you may have along the way!

A Little About Me

I joined the Bank in 2008 as a teller. After several years of branch experience, I was interested in the business banking side of things. In 2014, I became a Deposit Services Representative, and held various roles in cash management and business banking until being named the Business Banking Operations Manager last year. 

I earned a Bachelor of Arts in English from Eastern Global State University in 2010, and graduated from the Global School of Finance and Management in 2016.
